properties.name: release_claim's description names the claim it releases, so the findability ratchet holds
properties.rationale: CI's no_new_mutually_confusable_pair failed on PR #728 with one new pair although neither tool's text had changed: compare_designs' longer description added the word "in", df("in") moved 125 to 126 of 197, and the 0.024 margin between pin_at_epoch and release_claim on release_report's query was smaller than that shift. The test prescribes sharpening one description, and this is the sharpening that is also true: the sentence now names the claim rather than saying "what". Removing the standalone word "release" from release_claim's description was measured as the alternative and rejected: it would drop release_claim behind claim_region on its own query. This is a containment: the class (near-ties flipping on an unrelated common word) is recorded on the finding and left for a decision. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.stands_in_for: A findability ratchet that cannot flip on a noise-level margin: either the mutual-pair check carries a margin floor, or term weights are made insensitive to one description adding a common word; today any description edit anywhere moves every tool's score through document frequency, and pairs 0.02 apart flip.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: release_claim's second sentence said "releasing what nobody holds says so"; it now says "releasing a claim nobody holds says so". One word, and the only incidental match between release_claim's description and release_report's corpus query ("what is in this release and is it ready to cut"). Measured with the built binaries: release_claim's score on that query falls from 11.658 to 11.076 while pin_at_epoch stays at 11.638, so release_claim leaves the top 5 by 0.56 instead of sitting in it by 0.02, and the pair release_claim/release_report is no longer mutually confusable; release_claim still ranks first for its own job (25.688 over claim_region 25.225). All five findability tests pass; toolsnap release_claim.json regenerated; the surface-only-grows test, skill lint and tool_confusability pass. Why it was needed: fact:root-cause-the-findability-ratchet-flipped-on-an-unrelated-descriptions-common-word-2026-10-12.
